newsitem.title: USA: Noble Roman's credit line raised.
newsitem.headline: Noble Roman's credit line raised.

text.p: Noble Roman's Inc said Monday it reached an agreement with Provident Bank of Cincinnati to increase the company's credit facility by $1.7 million to $14.7 million and to restructure several of the facility's terms and convenants.

It said the revisions to the facility were made in exchange for issuance of a warrant to buy 65,000 shares of the company's common stock and the repricing of the existing warrant to purchase 400,000 shares at $2 per share.
President Paul Mobley said the chain of 84 company-owned and franchised pizza restaurants is now positioned to increase same-store sales and introduce newly created products.
